turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hello, Dr. Smith. It is very nice to meet you, too. Thank you for taking the time to see me. Um, well, I hope I'm explaining this right, and I really don't want to be a bother to anyone. My husband thought it would be a good idea for me to come in and talk, and I always try to do what's best. 

It's just... well, it's a family matter, mostly. I really hate to speak ill of people, I truly do, but it's about my husband's sister. She's been working our family business, and... well, I don't want to sound like a complainer, but she's doing it so she can get control of the money. She's been trying to push me completely out of the decisions. 

I know folks in the family keep trying to smooth it all over and make it seem like it's nothing, but... well, I know what I've been seeing. It's been going on for more than a year now. Does that make sense? I hope I'm not sounding unreasonable to you.

symptom_reasoning.S019: The patient expresses a fixed belief that her sister-in-law is plotting to take control of the family money and push her out, maintaining this belief despite family members contradicting her.
